findings.title: No documented rollback or recovery route for failed deliveries
findings.reason: The project has CI pipelines (5 workflows) and pre-commit hooks, but no explicit rollback, restore, or recovery procedure is documented in AGENTS.md, a runbook, or project docs. A failed delivery has no named recovery owner, entrypoint, or postcondition verification step.
expectedOutput: One owned recovery route is documented with the recovery owner, entrypoint, permission scope, and a verifiable postcondition for confirming service restoration.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Document the smallest recovery route for a failed delivery in AGENTS.md or a runbook. Name the recovery owner, entrypoint (git revert + redeploy), permission scope, and how to verify the postcondition.

## Validation

- Confirm the recovery owner and entrypoint are named
- Confirm the postcondition check is verifiable (e.g., CI green, health endpoint responds)

findings.title: Three exact memory title collisions and one near-similar pair require governance review

This does not prove duplicate body content but requires metadata review to confirm or resolve.
